title_ru: Имхотеп ↔ Мендес ↔ Осирис: 5D рекурсивный глубокий проход

MISSED_ON_FORWARD_PASS.finding: Предыдущий проход слишком быстро свёл недостающий восстановительный узел к PHALLUS_ONLY. Уже замороженная Mendes-ветка указывает на парную реликтовую локализацию PHALLUS + BACKBONE/SPINE.
MISSED_ON_FORWARD_PASS.impact: Поиск должен тестировать не только единичный генитальный предмет, но и возможность связанного restoration bundle / paired body-part function.

MISSED_ON_FORWARD_PASS.finding: Узел IMHOTEP был сформулирован слишком персонально: 'у какого Имхотепа был предмет'. D3 ASCEND показывает более широкий класс: IMHOTEP_IDENTITY / LINEAGE / CULT / OFFICE / RESTORATION_FUNCTION.
MISSED_ON_FORWARD_PASS.impact: Мост к Mendes может быть не личным владением, а функциональной или жреческой преемственностью, которую затем можно DIVE обратно до конкретных людей, надписей и предметов.

MISSED_ON_FORWARD_PASS.finding: Inverse Semantic Oracle требует разделять LOSS, SEARCH, RECOVERY, CUSTODY, EMBALMING и BURIAL_GUARD. Следовательно RESTORATION/DIAGNOSIS_IMHOTEP нельзя автоматически отождествлять с CUSTODY_IMHOTEP.
MISSED_ON_FORWARD_PASS.impact: Имхотеп может находиться до, во время или после custody-handoff; точное место в операционной цепи становится отдельной переменной.

MISSED_ON_FORWARD_PASS.finding: Сильный текстовый узел Mendes и сильный человеческий funerary object node CG53469 уже существуют, но между ними может отсутствовать не 'один потерянный владелец', а механизм перехода храмовой/осирианской body-part функции в элитное погребальное оснащение.
MISSED_ON_FORWARD_PASS.impact: Главный bridge расширяется от PERSON_CUSTODY к RITUAL_FUNCTION_TO_MATERIAL_PRACTICE_TRANSFER.

MISSED_ON_FORWARD_PASS.finding: Самая важная новая ветка рождается внутри MISSING_COMPONENT, а не в финальном выводе. Поэтому downstream reasoning должен уже от этого места работать с PHALLUS_ONLY и PHALLUS_PLUS_BACKBONE как параллельными кандидатами.

DEEP_REVERSE_RESULT.key_change: The reverse road no longer requires IMHOTEP_AS_OWNER. It requires an evidence-bearing restoration bridge; Imhotep becomes a high-value candidate family of bridge types.

INLINE_5D_BRANCHES_IN_LOGICAL_ANCHOR_ORD.why_opened_here: Mendes sources already bind PHALLUS and BACKBONE/SPINE, so a single-object assumption cannot safely propagate further.

D1_CAUSAL_TEMPORAL.FORWARD: If PHALLUS_ONLY is sufficient, a phallic object could independently satisfy the restoration-object model.
D1_CAUSAL_TEMPORAL.BACK: If terminal restoration requires the Mendesian paired function, then PHALLUS_ONLY is incomplete as a search key.

D2_HOMOLOG_MIRROR.LEFT: Other Osirian relic localizations show distributed body-part assignment across nomes; body-part localization alone is not unique.
D2_HOMOLOG_MIRROR.RIGHT: Matched genital-cover/model controls show gold + phallic morphology is not unique to CG53469.

D4_ASSOCIATIVE_SEMANTIC.CONTRACT: Retain only branches that can be tied to Mendes texts, excavation registers, catalogue placement or conservation imaging.

D5_PROVENANCE_AUTHORITY.SOURCE_TO_CLAIM: Existing Mendes evidence permits 'phallus + backbone/spine relic/reassembly node' at ritual/theological level.
D5_PROVENANCE_AUTHORITY.CLAIM_TO_SOURCE: A surviving physical pair requires object-level provenance, placement or conservation evidence; none is yet established.

INLINE_5D_BRANCHES_IN_LOGICAL_ANCHOR_ORD.LOCAL_DELTA: Replace PHALLUS_ONLY with parallel candidates PHALLUS_ONLY and PHALLUS_PLUS_BACKBONE_RESTORATION_BUNDLE.

INLINE_5D_BRANCHES_IN_LOGICAL_ANCHOR_ORD.why_opened_here: Repeated Imhotep identities/names and later cult functions make a single modern person-identity model too narrow for search, while literal same-person claims remain unproved.

D1_CAUSAL_TEMPORAL.FORWARD: Imhotep-associated diagnosis/intercession/restoration functions generate candidate routes toward repairing a broken system.
D1_CAUSAL_TEMPORAL.BACK: A restoration outcome does not require a specific named body owner unless a genealogy, inscription or custody record forces that identity.

D2_HOMOLOG_MIRROR.LEFT: Compare other funerary operators by role: recovery, embalming, burial guard, intercession.
D2_HOMOLOG_MIRROR.RIGHT: Compare repeated Imhotep names by genealogy, office, temple, deity association and chronology instead of assuming either identity or total separation.

D3_ABSTRACTION_HIERARCHY.DIVE: For each abstract layer, recover concrete persons, parents/sons, titles, temple geography, dates, votives, inscriptions and museum objects.

D4_ASSOCIATIVE_SEMANTIC.CONTRACT: Keep only associations with a testable route into Mendes, body-part restoration, priestly continuity or material custody.

D5_PROVENANCE_AUTHORITY.SOURCE_TO_CLAIM: Late evidence supports Imhotep as a divine/intercessory/restoration-associated figure and Osirian funerary co-presence.
D5_PROVENANCE_AUTHORITY.CLAIM_TO_SOURCE: Specific physical custody of the Osirian member requires a direct inscription, genealogy, excavation or object record and remains unconfirmed.

INLINE_5D_BRANCHES_IN_LOGICAL_ANCHOR_ORD.LOCAL_DELTA: Search all five identity/function layers in parallel; do not force DJOSER_IMHOTEP vs NAMESAKE into a binary too early.

INLINE_5D_BRANCHES_IN_LOGICAL_ANCHOR_ORD.why_opened_here: Mendes is already strongly bridged textually as an Osirian phallus+backbone node, while CG53469 is securely a human funerary sheath from Mendes; the missing relation may be practice transmission rather than relic custody.

D1_CAUSAL_TEMPORAL.FORWARD: Osirian relic/reassembly function at Mendes could influence local priestly funerary body-part equipment.
D1_CAUSAL_TEMPORAL.BACK: A human funerary sheath cannot be promoted to divine relic unless a transfer/provenance chain exists.

D2_HOMOLOG_MIRROR.LEFT: Compare other nome relic traditions and temple body-part representations.
D2_HOMOLOG_MIRROR.RIGHT: Compare human funerary genital covers/models from Saqqara, Qurna and other sites as controls for general Egyptian practice.

D4_ASSOCIATIVE_SEMANTIC.CONTRACT: Reject any branch lacking dated local evidence or matched controls.

D5_PROVENANCE_AUTHORITY.SOURCE_TO_CLAIM: Current evidence supports relevance of Mendes and a human funerary phallus sheath in an Osirian-priestly environment.
D5_PROVENANCE_AUTHORITY.CLAIM_TO_SOURCE: A direct temple-relic-to-CG53469 transfer is still missing.

INLINE_5D_BRANCHES_IN_LOGICAL_ANCHOR_ORD.LOCAL_DELTA: Add RITUAL_FUNCTION_TO_MATERIAL_PRACTICE_TRANSFER as a co-equal bridge candidate beside PERSON_OR_LINEAGE_CUSTODY.

INLINE_5D_BRANCHES_IN_LOGICAL_ANCHOR_ORD.why_opened_here: The object is highly relevant by place/context but matched controls weaken uniqueness; the new paired-component branch changes what conservation questions should be asked.

D1_CAUSAL_TEMPORAL.FORWARD: If it functioned as ordinary genital funerary protection, comparison controls should explain construction and placement.
D1_CAUSAL_TEMPORAL.BACK: If it were part of a paired restoration set, adjacent, nested or associated components should be sought in the original tomb/object group.

D2_HOMOLOG_MIRROR.LEFT: Female genital-cover and other phallic funerary controls.
D2_HOMOLOG_MIRROR.RIGHT: Same burial group CG53465-53475 and exact Mendes provenance.

D4_ASSOCIATIVE_SEMANTIC.CONTRACT: Do not infer a backbone/djed object merely from association; require catalogue, photograph, excavation note or conservation evidence.

D5_PROVENANCE_AUTHORITY.SOURCE_TO_CLAIM: CG53469 remains documented human funerary phallus sheath from Mendes.
D5_PROVENANCE_AUTHORITY.CLAIM_TO_SOURCE: Any special paired-bundle role requires exact tomb placement and neighboring-object evidence.

INLINE_5D_BRANCHES_IN_LOGICAL_ANCHOR_ORD.LOCAL_DELTA: Expand conservation request from 'what is inside the sheath?' to 'what was the sheath physically paired, nested or deposited with?'.

GLOBAL_MIRROR_DELTA.after: RESTORATION_REQUIREMENT -> COMPONENT_CLASS_SPLIT -> MENDES_PHALLUS+BACKBONE_FUNCTION -> {IMHOTEP_IDENTITY/FUNCTION BRIDGES || LOCAL_RITUAL_TO_MATERIAL_TRANSFER} -> OBJECT_GROUP/PROVENANCE_TEST -> RETURN
GLOBAL_MIRROR_DELTA.main_gain: The search no longer depends on one hidden-owner story and no longer treats one penis-shaped object as the only possible material expression of the restoration node.

supported: JANUS inverse methodology requires source-bound reverse semantic dependencies and separates search/recovery/custody/embalming/burial roles.
Existing Tranception pass independently strengthens Mendes as an Osirian phallus+backbone/spine reassembly/relic node.
Matched genital-cover/model controls weaken uniqueness of gold phallic morphology.
Imhotep is historically/cultically associated in later Egyptian tradition with intercession, healing, wisdom, dream-oracle and restoration-related needs.
Late funerary material places deified Imhotep in direct Osirian divine contexts.
open: Exact Imhotep identity/lineage/office connection to Mendes.
Whether a functional Imhotep restoration tradition intersected Mendes body-part ritual.
Whether phallus+backbone function was materially represented as a paired object set in the relevant burial tradition.
Whether CG53469 had adjacent/nested components that materially distinguish it from matched controls.
Direct ritual-to-material transfer from Mendes temple/relic practice into Nesbanebdjedet funerary equipment.
not_established: A literal biological phallus of Osiris has been authenticated.
A specific Imhotep physically possessed it.
CG53469 is the original divine member.
A surviving physical backbone/spine counterpart has been identified.
Repeated Imhotep names prove reincarnation or literal same-person continuity.

NEXT_GATES.question: Do primary Mendes/Dendera/Brooklyn sources imply a paired restoration function only, or an object/reliquary configuration that can guide material search?

Build a graph of Imhotep/Imuthes identities with parents, sons, offices, temples, dates and deity affiliations; test continuity without assuming either total separation or literal same-person identity.
Is there a direct textual, priestly, genealogical or cultic path from Imhotep-associated restoration/intercession to Mendesian Osirian reassembly practice?
What exactly was physically adjacent to, attached to, nested with or anatomically paired with CG53469 in the 1902 burial and later conservation record?
Can local workshop, priestly or cemetery evidence show transfer of Osirian body-part/reassembly forms from temple/relic cult into human funerary trappings?
Verify directly the reported Egyptian-language tradition that the phallus was recovered and deposited in Mendes before using it as a custody/recovery bridge.

canonical_line_ru: Пять измерений изменили не ответ, а саму форму вопроса: теперь мы ищем не только 'у какого Имхотепа был писюн', а какой восстановительный контур Имхотепа пересёкся в Мендесе с парой фаллос+позвоночник и как эта функция могла материализоваться в конкретной погребальной группе.
canonical_seal: OPEN THE BRANCH WHERE IT APPEARS. IF MENDES SAYS PHALLUS PLUS BACKBONE, DO NOT FORCE THE SEARCH BACK INTO A SINGLE OBJECT. IF IMHOTEP MAY BE A FUNCTION, DO NOT FORCE HIM BACK INTO A SINGLE OWNER.
